newRun.minutesHint: Leave empty for the profile default
run.noVideo: The video is not rendered yet.

topics.title: Seed topics
settings.title: Settings
settings.killSwitchHelp: Pauses the pipeline at the next stage boundary. Queued runs wait until you resume.
wizard.title: New video
wizard.inspiration.help: Paste 1 to 3 YouTube links you want to take inspiration from (Darija, Arabic, French or English). The app reads their transcripts for ideas and facts only; your video is researched and written from scratch.
wizard.inspiration.pasteHint: Use this if a video has no captions or YouTube blocks the download.
wizard.inspiration.skip: Skip, I will type a topic
wizard.inspiration.working: Reading transcripts and extracting ideas. This takes 1 to 3 minutes.
wizard.angle.story: What the videos are about (in our words)
wizard.angle.leads: {count} facts to verify in independent sources
wizard.angle.pick: Pick an angle (or write your own)
wizard.voice.help: Click play to hear a voice. Samples need the media service (local profile).
youtube.title: YouTube
youtube.notConfigured: Add GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET to .env and restart to enable YouTube.
publish.scheduled: Uploaded as private. Goes public automatically on {when} unless you veto.
kit.notReady: The publish kit appears when the run finishes.
kit.ready: Everything you need to post is in this folder:
kit.title: Title
prefs.title: Preferences (defaults for every new video)
prefs.burnCaptionsHelp: Off is usually better: captions.srt is uploaded separately and viewers can toggle it.
prefs.upscaleHelp: Real-ESRGAN 2x for sharper images (about 3 s per image). Off: faster Lanczos + sharpening.
prefs.publishZoneHelp: The publish time is in your audience's zone, not yours.
system.title: System check
system.notReady: {failures} problem(s) to fix before a run, {warnings} warning(s)
storage.title: Storage
storage.confirm: Delete the audio, images and renders of these runs? Export folders and run history are kept.
storage.help: Your finished videos, thumbnails and Shorts stay in storyforge-data/exports.
revise.notReady: The timeline appears once the pictures are planned.
revise.help: Watch the video. When something is off, press "Mark this moment" (or click a picture below), choose what to change and write a short note. Collect as many notes as you like, then press Apply: only the parts you pointed at are redone, everything else is reused.
revise.pick: Pick a moment in the video or a picture below
revise.placeholder.IMAGE: e.g. show the tent from outside, at night, snow storm; the person should be older
revise.placeholder.NARRATION: e.g. this part is slow, make it shorter and more tense; explain who Igor was
revise.placeholder.PACKAGE: e.g. the title should mention the year; the thumbnail needs a darker, scarier scene
revise.music.on: Whole video: music back to normal
revise.package.title: Title
revise.added: Note added. Add more or press Apply.
revise.applyConfirm: Redo the parts you pointed at and render the video again? A 12-minute video takes about 45 minutes; you get a notification when it is ready.
revise.applying: Rewriting the parts you pointed at...
revise.applied: Applied. The video is being rebuilt; this page updates by itself.
quick.title: Quick start: the app does everything
quick.help: Paste 1-3 YouTube links for inspiration, or just a topic, or nothing at all (the app takes the next topic from your backlog, and asks the AI for ideas when it is empty). Angle, voice, length and publish slot come from your Preferences.
quick.mainLink: YouTube link of the video to follow closely (optional)
quick.mainHelp: Its script becomes the base: same parts in the same order, about 80% of what it says (points, examples, opinions, jokes), retold in our own English sentences. The other links only add material.
quick.topic: Topic (optional), e.g. The Dyatlov Pass incident
quick.notes: Notes for the writer (optional), e.g. focus on the investigators, keep it eerie, no gore
prefs.channelBrief: Channel brief (used for AI topic ideas)
prefs.channelBriefHelp: Your niche, audience and tone in a few sentences. The autopilot and "Suggest with AI" pick topics that fit it.
prefs.hostHelp: Your channel logo (assets/channel/DownRightTalkingMouth.mp4) pops in at the opening, on the narrator's questions and at the outro, with its mouth moving to the voice.
prefs.clipsHelp: For videos about a film, series or anime: the app collects its trailers, teasers, TV spots and official clips (and any copy you put in storyforge-data\library\films), and shows the exact scene the narrator talks about, full screen and muted, under the commentary. A Content ID claim is still possible; QA lists every clip.
prefs.clipShareHelp: At most this much of the video may be the work's own footage. 70% is how film and anime channels look; lower it if you get Content ID claims.
progress.battery: The laptop is on battery: rendering is about 10x slower. Plug in the charger.
quick.readingHelp: Getting the transcripts and finding the best angle ({seconds} s). The video starts by itself and this page opens it.
quick.readFailed: The videos could not be read: {error}. Paste a transcript in the wizard below instead.
